# Now, let's send payment requests to the other roommates (Jordan and Kathryn) for their share of the taxi ($20 each) with the note "For Taxi".
venmo_access_token = venmo_login["access_token"]
results = []
for roommate in other_roommates:
    result = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=roommate["email"],
        amount=taxi_share,
        access_token=venmo_access_token,
        description="For Taxi"
    )
    results.append({"roommate": f"{roommate['first_name']} {roommate['last_name']}", "result": result})

print(results)
